signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Here's how to create your SolutionTee account. It takes about a minute.
signup.outro: That's it, you're in! Next, learn how to make your own custom exam.

chapters.say: Open the app and tap Get started.
chapters.caption: Tap **Get started**

chapters.say: Type your email address, then choose a password with at least eight characters.
chapters.caption: Type your **email** and a **password**

chapters.say: Tick the box to agree to the terms, then tap Create account.
chapters.caption: Tick the box, then tap **Create account**

chapters.say: We send a six digit code to your email. Type it in, and your email is verified.
chapters.caption: Type the **6-digit code** from your email

chapters.say: Now tell us about you. Type your full name, then choose your state and the year you were born.
chapters.caption: Your **name**, **state** and **year of birth**

chapters.say: When you're done, tap Continue.
chapters.caption: Tap **Continue**

chapters.say: Pick every exam you're writing. You can choose more than one.
chapters.caption: Pick **your exams**

chapters.say: Choose your three JAMB subjects. Use of English is already included.
chapters.caption: Choose your **3 JAMB subjects**

chapters.say: Tap Finish setup, and you're ready to practise.
chapters.caption: Tap **Finish setup**

custom.title: Make a custom exam
custom.intro: Want a test that's just right for you? Here's how to build your own custom exam.
custom.outro: Your custom exam is ready. Good luck! Next, learn how to use Community.

chapters.say: Go to the Test tab, and tap Custom exam.
chapters.caption: **Test** tab, then **Custom exam**

chapters.say: Tap a subject to remove it, or tap another subject to add it.
chapters.caption: Tap subjects to **add** or **remove** them

chapters.say: Slide to choose how many questions you want from each subject.
chapters.caption: Slide to set **how many questions**

chapters.say: Want to focus? Tap a topic, and you'll only get questions from that topic.
chapters.caption: Tap a **topic** to focus on it

chapters.say: Pick the years you want, or keep all your years.
chapters.caption: Pick the **years**

chapters.say: Then slide to set your time. You can also turn the clock off.
chapters.caption: Set the **time**

chapters.say: When you're happy, tap Start. Your custom exam opens, just like the real CBT.
chapters.caption: Tap **Start**

community.title: Use Community
community.intro: Community is where students ask questions, share tips and help each other. Here's how to use it.
community.outro: Be kind, help others, and keep learning together. Next, learn how to take a full JAMB mock.

chapters.say: Go to the Study tab, and tap Community.
chapters.caption: **Study** tab, then **Community**

chapters.say: Scroll the feed, and tap any post to open it and see the replies.
chapters.caption: Tap a **post** to open it

chapters.say: Like someone's posts? Tap Follow to see more of them in your Following tab.
chapters.caption: Tap **Follow**

chapters.say: To answer, tap the reply box. Type the at sign and a name, then pick the person you want to mention.
chapters.caption: Type **@** to mention someone

chapters.say: Write your reply, and tap Reply. It shows up in the thread straight away.
chapters.caption: Write it, then tap **Reply**

chapters.say: To ask your own question, go back to the feed and tap the plus button.
chapters.caption: Tap **+** to make a post

chapters.say: Type your question, and add a subject so the right people can find it.
chapters.caption: Write it and **add a subject**

chapters.say: Tap Post, and you're done. Your post is now live in the feed.
chapters.caption: Tap **Post**

mock.title: Take a full JAMB mock
mock.intro: Ready for the real thing? Here's how to take a full JAMB mock, and check your score.
mock.outro: Practise like this every week, and watch your score grow. Good luck!

chapters.say: Go to the Test tab, and tap Start full exam.
chapters.caption: **Test** tab, then **Start full exam**

chapters.say: Your four JAMB subjects are already set. Check them, then tap Start full exam.
chapters.caption: Check your subjects, then **Start**

chapters.say: The exam screen works like the real CBT. Tap an option to answer, then tap Next.
chapters.caption: Tap an **option**, then **Next**

chapters.say: Not sure? Tap the flag, and come back to it later.
chapters.caption: Tap the **flag** to come back later

chapters.say: Tap a subject at the top to switch subjects at any time.
chapters.caption: Tap a **subject** to switch

chapters.say: Need to calculate? Tap the calculator icon, work it out, then close it.
chapters.caption: Use the **calculator**

chapters.say: Tap the grid icon to see every question. Tap any number to jump straight to it.
chapters.caption: Tap the **grid** to jump to any question

chapters.say: Your answers save as you go, even if you close the app. When you've finished, tap Submit.
chapters.caption: Answers save as you go. Tap **Submit**

chapters.say: Check your summary, then tap Submit now.
chapters.caption: Check, then **Submit now**

chapters.say: You get your score out of four hundred straight away, with a score for each subject.
chapters.caption: Your **score out of 400**

chapters.say: Tap Review answers to see what you got wrong, and ask SolutionTee AI to explain it.
chapters.caption: **Review answers** and learn
